nodes.description: The sialic-acid-rich GBS capsular polysaccharide, together with membrane glycolipids, mediates evasion of the neonatal immune defence, a key virulence determinant and the basis of serotype-specific protection. The terminal sialylated units molecularly mimic host sialoglycans and engage the inhibitory neutrophil receptor Siglec-9, blunting the oxidative burst, degranulation and neutrophil extracellular trap formation.
